name: The Stone Crown
summary: The great northern range: nine summits ringed like a circlet, home of the deep-folk holds and the headwaters of the Weavers' River. The Sundering struck it first — Orbren's hammer-fall, the sagas say — and the range has been settling, groaning, and keeping secrets ever since.

geography.character: granite massif, glacier-fed valleys, passes held by fortress and custom

peaks.name: The Hammerhead
peaks.note: Highest summit; struck first by the Sundering, its scar-face visible from the Greenwood on clear days.

peaks.name: The Circlet
peaks.note: The ring of nine around the high vale; each clan claims one crown-stone.

notable_sites.name: The True Place
notable_sites.note: The deep sanctum where the High Concord gathered and where hardliners still speak forbidden words into the dark.

lore_notes: 'The Quiet tears open from the Stone Crown' — the scar begins in these foothills and runs southwest across the world.
Northmarch exists because somebody must hold the passes between the Crownlands and this range — and because the ore is good.
Line analysis of prophecy fragments 'points somewhere east of the Stone Crown'; pilgrim-scholars keep arriving with shovels and bad maps.
adventure_hooks: A clan hires outsiders to carry a sealed case to the Hammerhead's scar-face and bury it — at a specific hour, without reading the case.
The mountain settles two inches overnight and every seer within a hundred miles wakes at the same moment.
